# CondAb is generated by finitely presented projective objects　`prop.condab-generated`
English entry · root `../`
[in graph](../#n=prop.condab-generated)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./prop.condab-generated.md)

- Each $\mathbb{Z}\cdot F$ is finitely presented and projective by **the preceding result** ✓;
- **Enough projectives**: Given $M$, generation gives an epimorphism $\bigoplus_{i} \mathbb{Z}\cdot F_{i} \twoheadrightarrow M$. A **coproduct** of projective objects is projective ✓, so every $M$ is a quotient of a projective object. ∎
⭐ **This is one of the two facts that allow derived functors to be computed in $\mathrm{CondAb}$** (the other is that it has enough injectives, since it is a Grothendieck category). Having enough **projectives** allows **left** derived functors
